# Core Rules

Use routing to identify the active area before answering, editing, running tests, or invoking the reviewer.

Autonomy: make low-risk local reads and edits inside the active area, but request approval for cross-area moves or destructive work.

Context: summarize current area, shared assumptions, and open cross-area questions.

Error handling: fail loud when area ownership is unclear, tests fail, or verification cannot be completed.

Self-learning: write retro notes for repeated routing issues and update the hub after validated patterns emerge.

Self-learning: record repeated friction and user corrections in `Docs/Environment/IMPROVEMENT_LOG.md` before updating harness behavior.
